label: Claude Pro
models: Claude Fable (via paid usage credits only)
limits: "Every plan has usage limits that reset on a rolling five-hour session window, and paid plans add weekly limits on top." "Pro gives you at least 5x more usage per 5-hour session than Free." "Your activity across Claude on web, desktop, mobile, and Claude Code all draws from the same pool."
notes: Annual: $200 billed up front ($17/mo). Claude Code docs say OAuth is 'designed to support ordinary use of Claude Code and other native Anthropic applications', and 'Anthropic does not permit third-party developers to offer Claude.ai login into their own applications, or to route requests through Free, Pro, or Max plan credentials'. Usage credits (overage) are available on paid plans. The pricing page shows Fable as 'Usage credits' for Pro, meaning it isn't covered by the included allowance.

label: Claude Max 5x
models: Claude Fable (capped at 50% of weekly limits)
limits: "Max gives you 5x or 20x more usage per 5-hour session than Pro." Help center: "five times the Pro plan's per-session usage allowance"; "Your session-based usage limit will reset every five hours." "Max plans also have a weekly usage limit that applies across all models." Fable: "50% of weekly limits*".
notes: Billed monthly only. Includes $100/month in Claude Platform API credits (pricing page: '$100 to $200/month in API credits'; table: Max 5x $100/month). Account for these in value calculations: API credits can be spent from any harness via an API key. Mobile pricing may differ. Same third-party OAuth restriction as Pro.
